variables.name: SYSCTL_IPV4_ICMP_ECHO_IGNORE_BROADCASTS
variables.description: Required value of net.ipv4.icmp_echo_ignore_broadcasts. The check fails when the kernel value differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_IPV4_ICMP_IGNORE_BOGUS_ERROR_RESP
variables.description: Required value of net.ipv4.icmp_ignore_bogus_error_responses. The check fails when the kernel value differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_IPV4_TCP_SYNCOOKIES
variables.description: Required value of net.ipv4.tcp_syncookies. The check fails when the kernel value differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_IPV4_ALL_SEND_REDIRECTS
variables.description: Required value of net.ipv4.conf.all.send_redirects, net.ipv4.conf.default.send_redirects. The check fails when a listed key differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_IPV4_ALL_ACCEPT_SOURCE_ROUTE
variables.description: Required value of net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route, net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route, net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_source_route, net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_source_route. The check fails when a listed key differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_IPV4_ALL_ACCEPT_REDIRECTS
variables.description: Required value of net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects, net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects, net.ipv6.conf.all.accept_redirects, net.ipv6.conf.default.accept_redirects. The check fails when a listed key differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_IPV4_ALL_SECURE_REDIRECTS
variables.description: Required value of net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects, net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects. The check fails when a listed key differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_IPV4_ALL_LOG_MARTIANS
variables.description: Required value of net.ipv4.conf.all.log_martians, net.ipv4.conf.default.log_martians. The check fails when a listed key differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_IPV4_ALL_RP_FILTER
variables.description: Required value of net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter, net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter. The check fails when a listed key differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_FS_SUID_DUMPABLE
variables.description: Required value of fs.suid_dumpable. The check fails when a listed key differs.

variables.name: SYSCTL_KRN_RANDOMIZE_VA_SPACE
variables.description: Required value of kernel.randomize_va_space. The check fails when a listed key differs.

variables.name: PASS_MAX_DAYS
variables.description: Maximum password age in days. The check fails above this.

variables.name: MODE_GRUB_CFG
variables.description: Octal mode ceiling (600). The default keeps the original check; any other value is a maximum mode and a stricter mode passes.

variables.name: INACTIVE_DAYS
variables.description: Maximum inactive-password lock in days. Zero and negative shadow ages still follow the original shadow test.

variables.name: MAX_AUTH_TRIES
variables.description: Maximum SSH MaxAuthTries.

variables.name: SSH_IGNORE_RHOSTS
variables.description: Required sshd IgnoreRhosts. The default keeps the original helper, including an unset value.

variables.name: SSH_HOSTBASED_AUTH
variables.description: Required sshd HostbasedAuthentication. The default keeps the original helper, including an unset value.

variables.name: PERMIT_ROOT_LOGIN
variables.description: Required sshd PermitRootLogin. The default keeps the original helper, including an unset value.

variables.name: SSH_PERMIT_EMPTY_PASSWORDS
variables.description: Required sshd PermitEmptyPasswords. The default keeps the original helper, including an unset value.

variables.name: SSH_PERMIT_USER_ENV
variables.description: Required sshd PermitUserEnvironment. The default keeps the original helper, including an unset value.

variables.name: CLIENT_ALIVE_COUNT_MAX
variables.description: Maximum sshd ClientAliveCountMax.

variables.name: LOGIN_GRACE_TIME
variables.description: Maximum SSH LoginGraceTime in seconds.
